stemMd: Not all submissions were anonymous. What does that necessarily mean?

options.label: B
options.textMd: At least one submission was not anonymous.

explanationMd: Not all denies the universal claim and therefore requires at least one exception. It leaves open whether other submissions were anonymous. A denial of all is not equivalent to none.

distractorRationale.d: This stronger statement is not required.
